messages:
kevin: Heads-up — new model onboarding intake: Hera-7B (adaptive quant). Need prioritization + a short bring-up checklist focused on perf and quality. Goals: hosted target p95 < 120ms @ typical 8k ctx, throughput >= 0.9x current 7B baseline. Tasks: ctx-length sweeps (512 / 2048 / 8192), batch profiles (1,2,4,8), int8/int4 adaptive quant smoke, and prompt-based quality evals.

olivia: Got it. Drop the initial perf command and sample sizes and I can run the first sweep later today.

kevin: Plan snippet to run for smoke (feel free to tweak):
```
perf-run --model hera-7b --quant adaptive-int4 --ctx 512,2048,8192 --batch 1,2,4,8 --warmup 200 --samples 500 --metrics latency,throughput,p95 --streaming true
```
(also include --kv-cache on for long-ctx runs)

sam: I can spin up a short dedicated pool (1 A100 x4 hrs) for the smoke runs. Requesting approval window now.

kevin: thanks. add warmup policy to 200 steps and a longer warmup for the 8k ctx (500). Also include a tiny tail-latency probe (single longgen 16k with streaming).

tess: For quality gating: run prompt set pr-hera-001 and compare against current production 7b baseline. Metrics: BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim, hallucination heuristics, and a safety policy scan. If quality delta (embedding-sim) drops > 1.5% or safety flags increase -> block rollout.

olivia: I'll add KV/prefix cache toggles to the scripts so we can see perf w/ and w/o prefix caching. Also will generate a batch heatmap (latency vs batch size vs ctx).

kevin: Add automatic fallback: if p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5% during canary -> auto-route to 7b-legacy. Also include a rollout ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with eval checks at each step.

ci-bot: Perf job queued: job_id=hera-adaptive-2026-03-20-01, queue_pos=2, ETA ~30m

raj: I'll run the full quality sweep after the perf smoke and post a short report (delta tables + a few failed prompts). ETA EOD.

kevin: Prioritization: proposed P1 for Dedicated onboarding (we want to prove perf); P2 for Hosted GA. Decision and initial results by EOD tomorrow pls. @tess can you confirm the SLA thresholds you want us to gate on?

tess: Confirming SLA gates: hosted p95 < 120ms and error_rate < 0.2%; dedicated p95 < 100ms. Also require no regression >1.5% embedding-sim. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Great. TL;DR checklist for tracker: 1) infra pool (sam), 2) perf scripts + ctx sweeps (olivia), 3) adaptive quant smoke (olivia), 4) batch heatmap (olivia), 5) quality evals/pr-hera-001 (raj), 6) rollout policy + fallback (kevin/tess), 7) doc PR for onboarding notes (kevin). I'll open the tracker issue and link results here.

olivia: I'll post the first heatmap and the raw perf CSVs here when done.

sam: infra done — pool provisioned, access granted to eng-ml team, job slot details posted to the infra channel.

ci-bot: Perf job hera-adaptive-2026-03-20-01 started on node=a100-42, ETA 18m

kevin: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in this thread with results and prioritization decision.
